body.condition: For every arm with \(\gamma_a<\infty\), \(F_a^{\pi}(t)=c_at^{\gamma_a-1}\{1+O(t^{\rho_a})\}\) as \(t\downarrow0\), with a remainder envelope, validity threshold, and positive parameter bounds common over the class.

novel.justification: This uniform second-order form strengthens the anchor's lawwise regular variation. Compact boundary-power charts with Hölder remainders satisfy it by uniform inversion.
